intent: First launch to a prefilled Brief in six quiet screens, all skippable. The couple picks a language (layout flips at once), sees three promises, then answers who is planning, the date, guests and budget, and areas. Answers are stored on the device for guests and become the global Brief (ADR 0007 D3) that drives price and availability on every card. No account is requested here.

screens.purpose: First-ever screen. The couple chooses Arabic or English; direction flips immediately and the choice persists. Returning users can jump straight to sign-in.
interactions: Tap a language card: the whole screen mirrors in place (200 ms, no restart) and the choice is persisted
Continue goes to the intro slides
Quiet text link 'I already have an account' / «لدي حساب بالفعل» opens the sign-in sheet
Device language is preselected; if the device is neither Arabic nor English, Arabic is preselected
screens.contentNotes: Full-bleed photograph of an empty ballroom with kosha florals (no people), wordmark غزل in the Arabic UI and Ghazal in the English UI. Two large cards, each written in its own script: «العربية» and 'English'; selected state is an ink border plus a check, never gold alone. One quiet line in both languages: «يمكنكم تغيير اللغة لاحقًا من حسابكم» / 'You can change the language later in Profile'. No flags. The digit style is not asked here (ADR 0010): Western digits are the default in Arabic. The screen is bundled and works fully offline. Tab bar hidden.

screens.purpose: Three swipeable, skippable slides with one promise each. Skipping goes straight to Home with an empty Brief.
interactions: Swipe or tap Next between three slides; the first slide sits at the right in Arabic and swipes advance leftwards
A 2px thread page indicator draws on as slides advance (320 ms, fills in reading direction)
Skip (top, inline-end) goes to the Discover Home with no Brief
Last slide CTA 'Get started' / «البدء» goes to the planning questions
screens.contentNotes: Slide 1: 'Compare up to three halls side by side' / «مقارنة بين ثلاث قاعات جنبًا إلى جنب». Slide 2: 'See which dates are free before you ask' / «التواريخ المتاحة تظهر لكم مباشرة». Slide 3: 'Everything for the wedding in one place' / «كل تفاصيل الزفاف في مكان واحد». Imagery is empty-room details only (long table setting, floral arch, chandelier, a seating-layout plan); no people, no alcohol, no ornamental gold calligraphy. Headlines are noun phrases, not plural imperatives (ADR 0013). No autoplay video. Tab bar hidden.

screens.purpose: Capture the planner's role and names so the monogram, countdown and Wedding info start filled. Optional and editable later.
interactions: Single-choice chips: Bride / Groom / A family member / Wedding planner («العروس» «العريس» «أحد أفراد العائلة» «منسّق الأعراس»); none is preselected
Full name field (dir=auto, Arabic or Latin) and optional partner name field; no first/last split (ADR 0012)
Live monogram preview: first letter of the name in its own script («ر» for ريم الدوسري) on a Rose-tint disk
Skip text link; Continue goes to the date
screens.contentNotes: Prefill example for the demo persona: role 'Bride', name «ريم الدوسري» / Reem Al-Dosari, partner «فهد الشمري» / Fahad Al-Shammari. Family members and planners are first-class answers so a mother or a planner can use the app without feeling like a guest of someone else's wedding. No photo upload, no avatar picker (monograms only, ADR 0015). Arabic helper text avoids gendered second-person verbs. All fields skippable; every answer is editable in Profile > Wedding info (CL-PROF-02). Tab bar hidden.

screens.purpose: Set the wedding date or mark it undecided. This is the full-screen version of the shared date picker later reused as the Brief date sheet.
interactions: Custom single-date calendar (no native picker): month paging, 12-month jump sheet, Sunday-first with the Thu-Sat peak band as one Rose-tint block at the inline-end edge
Selecting a date shows a muted Hijri line in the Arabic UI only and the day count ('63 days to go' / «باقي 63 يومًا»)
Two alternatives under the grid: 'Not decided yet' / «لم نحدد بعد» and 'Flexible month' (opens a 12-month picker)
Past dates are Closed (32% ink, no strike); Skip and Continue go to guests and budget
screens.contentNotes: Demo selection: Thu 14 Jan 2027 shown as «الخميس 14 يناير 2027» with the muted line «6 شعبان 1448 هـ», EN 'Thursday 14 January 2027'. Occasion markers are approximate until announced: Isra and Miraj Tue 5 Jan 2027 (إسراء ومعراج، تقريبي); Ramadan 1448 as a 2px gold-ink underline from Mon 8 Feb to about Mon 8 Mar with legend chip «رمضان 1448 (تقريبي)» / 'Ramadan 1448 (approx.)'; National Day Thu 25 Feb and Liberation Day Fri 26 Feb. Weekday header in Arabic uses full words (أحد اثنين ثلاثاء أربعاء خميس جمعة سبت) at the 13px caption. Never ليلة plus a weekday. Digits are Western. Tab bar hidden.

screens.purpose: Set the guest count and the venue-and-catering budget together, because per-guest pricing makes them one decision in Kuwait.
interactions: Guest stepper plus preset chips (100, 150, 200, 300, 400, 500, 650, 800, 1,000+); hard cap 1,500
Optional toggle 'Separate ladies' and men's receptions' reveals two steppers (Ladies 350, Men 400); the Brief guest count follows the section the venue is searched for
Budget bands as chips (under 5,000 | 5,000 - 10,000 | 10,000 - 20,000 | 20,000 - 35,000 | 35,000+) plus a custom range slider with a mirrored histogram
Skip either half independently; Continue goes to areas
screens.contentNotes: Budget label is «ميزانية القاعة والضيافة» / 'Venue and catering budget' so it is never confused with total wedding spend (ADR 0012, 0018). Demo answers: guests 350 («350 ضيفًا»), split Ladies 350 and Men 400, band 20,000 - 35,000 shown «من 20,000 إلى 35,000 د.ك» / 'KD 20,000 – 35,000'. Helper line beneath the band: 'Roughly KD 57 – 100 per guest at 350 guests' / «تقريبًا من 57 إلى 100 د.ك للضيف عند 350 ضيفًا». ICU plurals for guests (ضيفان, 3 ضيوف, 11 ضيفًا). Inputs accept Eastern-Arabic digits and normalise to Western on entry (ADR 0010). Open question flagged: ADR 0007 D3 calls the onboarding budget the total wedding budget while ADR 0012 and 0018 label the Brief budget venue and catering; this inventory follows the labelled venue-and-catering meaning and seeds the total in CL-WEDD-03 separately. Tab bar hidden.

screens.purpose: Multi-select Kuwait areas grouped by governorate, then finish onboarding with a live count of matching halls. Reused as the area picker in the Brief sheet and filters.
interactions: Searchable list grouped under the six governorates (العاصمة، حولي، الفروانية، الأحمدي، الجهراء، مبارك الكبير); tap areas to multi-select; each group header shows its selected count
Search uses Arabic normalisation and an alias table (Mishref = مشرف / Mishrif / Meshref; Salmiya = السالمية / Salmiyah)
Sticky gold CTA with a live count: 'Show 3 halls' / «عرض 3 قاعات»; with nothing selected it reads 'Show all 21 halls' / «عرض كل القاعات»
CTA stores the Brief on the device and opens Home; 'Skip' opens Home with no area
screens.contentNotes: Demo selection: Salmiya (السالمية, Hawalli) and Sharq (شرق, Capital). With the 21-venue roster this yields 3 venues: Aurelia Gulf Hotel, Lumi Marina Hotel, Jawharat Al-Salmiya Palace. Governorate contents: Capital (Sharq, Bneid Al-Qar, Shuwaikh, Dasma); Hawalli (Salmiya, Jabriya, Mishref, Salwa, Bayan, Hateen); Farwaniya (Khaitan, Jleeb Al-Shuyoukh, Al-Rai); Ahmadi (Fintas, Mahboula, Khiran); Mubarak Al-Kabeer (Messila, Qurain, Sabah Al-Salem); Jahra (Taima, Oyoun). Area names show in the UI language only. No location permission is requested here (asked later, in context, for Nearby). Tab bar hidden.
